name: 1000-nen no Kaze
source:
1000 years ago a great sorcerer created the barrier between Hades and Earth that has lasted until today, heralding a thousand years of peace and prosperity. It is a marvel of magic that none has ever come close to replicating. When Yuta Abe grasps that unique, phenomenal power he is corrupted by it. This is his story of redemption as a human being.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142445.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
1000年前，一位强大的术士在冥界与人间之间筑起结界。它延续至今，带来千年的和平与繁荣。这堪称魔法奇迹，从未有人能接近、更遑论重现。当Yuta Abe掌握了这份独一无二的惊人力量时，却遭到了它的腐蚀。这是他找回人性、走向救赎的故事。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142445.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
